text:
Alex M.: Hey team — first day! Trying to finish SSO/MFA setup. Enrolled Okta on my Mac but when I try to add a passkey from iPad it sends me into Okta Device Trust every time and then 1Password still shows "seat pending". Who should I ping?
Maya S.: welcome Alex! for passkeys we usually register via the web Okta session then approve on device. Quick Q: is your iPad on the same Apple ID as iCloud Keychain?
Alex M.: yes Apple ID is same. iPadOS 17.4. When I tap "create passkey" in Okta it opens Safari and then pops a modal: "device not registered - start device trust". Then it asks for company MDM which I already enrolled.
Jamal R.: hmm — sometimes the Device Trust check dislikes the iPad's user agent. Two ideas: 1) try creating passkey on the Mac (Safari) and then approve with iPad via Handoff; 2) check Okta device record for your Mac and iPad.
Lina T.: also FYI 1Password seat relies on Google Workspace provisioning. If your GSuite account got a duplicate alias it can stall. Alex — can you paste the domain part of your email (no full email) and whether you see the 1Password invite link in your personal email?
Alex M.: domain is redwood-inference.com. No personal invite. Only the initial Okta invite arrived.
IT Support (bot): Ticket #INC-2024-298 created for Alex M. — IT will look into Okta device records and Google Workspace provisioning. ETA 2 hours.
Jamal R.: In the meantime try this quick flow: on Mac open Safari > okta.redwood-inference.com > Security > Create passkey. If it gives the same error, run in dev console to see network call to /api/v1/devicetrust (just to confirm). If you want, post the small snippet here (screenshot is fine).
Alex M.: tried creating on Mac — same redirect loop. Screenshot attached (not in this export) says "policy: require_device_trust".
Lina T.: thanks. tagging IT to check GSuite sync and duplicate user. @IT Support (bot) — can you confirm if an alias existed for alex.m?
IT Support (bot): Checked — duplicate alias found (alex@contractors.redwood-inference.com) which prevented Google account from being linked to primary seat. Cleared alias and re-ran SCIM provisioning. 1Password seat now provisioned.
Alex M.: sweet — 1Password just activated. Thanks!
IT Support (bot): Okta device record still showed iPad as unregistered due to stale Device Trust certificate. Pushed a remote re-enroll command; please open Okta Verify on iPad and accept the prompt.
Alex M.: accepted prompt, then retried passkey creation on Mac and approved via iPad handoff — success! Passkey created and SSO flows smooth.
Maya S.: welcome aboard :tada: Ping me if you want a quick orientation to infra repos.
Alex M.: thanks everyone — appreciate the help :heart:
